selection_basis.decision: tested-model campaigns freeze at concurrency 3 (stable throughput with the strongest sustained evidence); level 4 probed clean and remains approved headroom for auxiliary roles

provider_transient.semantics: RETRYABLE_INFRA_FAILURE units are re-executed on resume; never counted as model results
